overview.description: The YieldMax SPCX Option Income Strategy ETF (YSPC) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in communication services equity. The fund seeks to provide current income and capped gains on the Space Exploration Technologies Corporation (NASDAQ: SPCX) through a synthetic covered call strategy. The actively managed fund uses both standardized exchange-traded and FLEX options YSPC was launched on Jul 14, 2026 and is issued by YieldMax.
